# Isaiah Chapter 47 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 15 verses]*

*Virgin daughter Babylon humbled; loss of children; astrologers cannot save; no deliverer*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 47 (Fall of Babylon) addresses virgin daughter babylon humbled; loss of children; astrologers cannot save; no deliverer. The key verse — "You felt secure in your wickedness; you said, No one sees me" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to Second Isaiah (chs. 40-55), focused on comfort, restoration, and the servant figure.
